"""Repro for Django ticket #29224: deleting index_together crashes when
unique_together exists on the same fields."""
import django
from django.conf import settings

settings.configure(
    DATABASES={"default": {"ENGINE": "django.db.backends.sqlite3", "NAME": ":memory:"}},
    INSTALLED_APPS=["django.contrib.contenttypes", "django.contrib.auth"],
    DEFAULT_AUTO_FIELD="django.db.models.AutoField",
)
django.setup()

from django.db import models, connection  # noqa: E402


class Pony(models.Model):
    pink = models.IntegerField(default=1)
    weight = models.IntegerField(default=1)

    class Meta:
        app_label = "repro"
        unique_together = {("pink", "weight")}
        index_together = {("pink", "weight")}


with connection.schema_editor() as editor:
    editor.create_model(Pony)

# Delete index_together (unique_together stays) — this is the crashing path.
with connection.schema_editor() as editor:
    editor.alter_index_together(Pony, {("pink", "weight")}, set())

print("SUCCESS: index_together removed without ValueError")
